items.name: split
items.title: Split
items.description: Two-pane list/detail layout that stacks below a container width breakpoint. Used by the system menu.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project. Layout primitive for YoRHa-styled screens; two panes; 1px divider between them by default (divider, default true). Migration (v3): Split drew no rule before v3, so pass divider={false} where the detail is already framed (system-menu-layout does). The split is fixed, with no drag handle. Gaps are fixed in every density (B1).
